Scenario fixture: heading-order

01 — CANTTELL: heading level jumps from 1 to 3, skipping level 2

Skipped level

Level 4, one below the h3

Going back up to level 2 is fine

02 — CANTTELL: heading level jumps from 2 to 4, although an earlier h4 was already reached

Share the page

03 — NEUTRAL: a hidden h6 is not part of the outline, so the h5 after the h4 is one level down
Hidden heading
One level below the h4

This rule needs at least two headings to evaluate, and the violation is inherently a relationship between two headings rather than a single element, so each case is judged against the heading exposed just before it. The PASS cases (consecutive levels; going back up to a shallower level) are covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file.
